name: A DRV pension of a German national living in Italy (Germany as the paying country)
workings: The planner passes only the German pensions the plan says Germany taxes; the treaty (Art. 19(4)) gives Germany the DRV pension of a German national who isn't Italian
2031, the year after the start: the exempt 14% × 20,409.60 = 2,857.344 is fixed (kept in the state for later years, wherever the person lives); taxable 17,552.256 − 102 = 17,450.256

All the income Germany sees is German, so it's taxed as a resident's on application (§1 Abs. 3): the basic allowance and the 36 special-expenses lump sum, with a warning that other income abroad would undo it
Taxable income 17,414.256; T = 944.002663; no Soli, no church tax
Without §1 Abs. 3 it would be T(17,450.256 + 12,348) = 4,160.32 (case drv-pension-non-resident-limited)
